questions.answer: A change propagates around a closed causal path in a direction that amplifies it.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: Does balancing feedback always produce good results?
questions.answer: No; it can also sustain an unwanted state or oscillate when delayed.
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.prompt: What turns a causal chain into a loop?
questions.answer: A causal path returning to influence an earlier variable.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Constructs signed closed loops and explains their hypothesised behaviour and limits.
scoring.transfer: Build one reinforcing and one balancing loop around the same stock from L01. Explain how a resource limit could alter which loop dominates.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
